blurb: Fargo Jet Center and its subsidiary Premier Jet Center provide full-service FBO including refueling, maintenance, avionics, aircraft charter and management, interior and paint services. Premier Jet Center also offers aircraft sales, brokerage, and acquisitions through Exclusive Aircraft Sales. Fargo Jet Center operates a Cessna-certified flight school.
